The Helixon standard

Quality is a document, not a promise

Anyone can print a purity figure on a label. What makes it meaningful is the paperwork underneath it — a named method, a measured result, a date, and a lot number that ties all three together. Every Helixon lot clears the same seven checks before it is released, and each one appears as a line item you can read.

7Checks per lot
1Batch number
0Unverified releases
01 Purity RP-HPLC
02 Net content Gravimetric
03 Identity ESI-MS
04 Endotoxin LAL
05 Sterility Compendial
06 Conformity Record review
07 Contaminant screening ICP-MS

Why Helixon

Built around verification

Every lot clears the same checks before release, and each result is written to a record you can retrieve.

Batch traceable

The batch number on the vial retrieves its record. One identifier, one document set.

Independent testing

An external laboratory runs the panel on the finished lot and its result set is published as received.

Identity verified

Observed mass is checked against the value calculated for the stated sequence.

Purity tested

Reverse-phase HPLC reports purity as area percent, with the chromatogram retained.

Contaminants screened

Endotoxin and residual elemental content are measured and reported on the same document.

COA available

No lot is listed without its certificate attached, searchable before you order.

About Helixon Solutions

A research supply company built around one idea: a result is only useful if you can trace where it came from.

Who we are

Research materials, released against a record

Helixon Solutions supplies lyophilised research compounds to laboratories that need to know exactly what they received. Every lot is synthesised to a written specification, tested by an independent laboratory, and released only once its analytical record is complete.

We do not publish a purity figure without the chromatogram behind it. The batch number printed on the vial is the same identifier that retrieves the certificate of analysis, so the paperwork travels with the material rather than behind it.
